item.title: Ofcom investigates GB News over guest’s pride and paedophilia remarks
item.summary: Regulator acts after 12,000 complaints over comments by Caroline Farrow linking parades with bestiality and paedophilia GB News is being investigated by the UK’s media regulator after a guest appeared to link pride parades with bestiality and paedophilia. The remarks are thought to have set a new record for individual complaints about a GB News programme, with more than 12,000 people raising concerns about comments made by the guest Caroline Farrow.
